evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and modifies src/httprpc.cpp and src/rpc/protocol.h.
rationale: Fixes -rpcwhitelist denials returning empty HTTP 403 responses, which violates JSON-RPC 2.0 specifications and causes bitcoin-cli over IPC to fail with JSON type decoding errors. Returning structured error codes (-38 and -39) restores protocol compliance and provides informative error payloads to downstream clients.
